text:
elena: Cutover window for atlas-v2 enable tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC. Pin list updated in the catalog. Need final ack + rollback criteria. Please call out any SLO concerns.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: enable atlas-v2 on model-catalog at 2024-11-03T03:00:00Z. Canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 20m. Auto-rollback on error rate >1% or p95 latency >1200ms. See /deploy logs.

samir: ACK. Quick q: what's fallback ordering if atlas-v2 hits mem pressure? we should prefer quantized-orbit then legacy-boron, right?

elena: yes — fallback ladder: atlas-v2 (primary) -> orbit-quant (same family) -> boron-legacy (lower perf). I'll attach the pin file.

priya: Uploading release notes and prompt-regression alerts now. Are we keeping 5% canary for 10m or 20m? longer helps evals.

elena: Let's do 5% for 10m, then 25% for 10m, then 100% if no regressions. We'll monitor the evals dashboard and keep manual hold if quality dips. :eyes: 

joel: Adding drain plan — we'll drain 30% from warm nodes prior to canary to avoid cold starts. Command snippet:
```
rollout:
  - step: canary
    percent: 5
    hold: 600s
  - step: ramp
    percent: 25
    hold: 600s
  - step: full
    percent: 100
```

samir: Good. For rollback criteria add 'fallback-ordering failure' alert: if model fails to route to fallback within 60s for >0.1% of requests -> rollback.

elena: added to checklist. Also tagging infra on-call for the change window: @joel can you confirm region fans out? If we need to exclude cn region, now is the time.

joel: Confirmed EU/US fanout only. CN excluded. I'll cut the region flag in deploy config.

ci-bot: Preflight checks: model artifact validated, checksum ok, quantized variant present, integration tests: 178/180 passed (2 flaky tests). Manual approval required.

priya: Manual approval from product (release notes reviewed) — :thumbsup: 

elena: approving. Final checklist done. If anything goes sideways, priority is to pin traffic back to prev-version and escalate to SRE. Thanks team. :rocket:
